description: Machine-readable registry of AiXia QA issue categories for Synthetic User QA and council routing.

categories.name: Design Issue
categories.definition: A visual, layout, UI, UX, responsiveness, spacing, typography, shared-design-system, or user clarity problem.
examples: Different font sizes between equivalent pages
Local card design instead of shared components
Avatar placement or visual guidance problems
requiredEvidence: Suspected shared component or CSS source when relevant
fixPromptRules: Inspect shared AiXia source of truth first.
Prefer shared component and shared CSS fixes over page-local patches.
Do not change business logic for design-only issues.
Escalate to Functional Engineering Panel if the visual issue is caused by broken interaction wiring.

categories.name: Functional Issue
categories.definition: A user action, workflow, button, form, modal, tab, upload, search, filter, sort, create, edit, archive, delete, restore, or interaction does not work correctly.
likelyRootCauses: Backend or Supabase failure surfaced in UI
fixPromptRules: Preserve app logic unless the issue truly requires a logic fix.
Identify whether the cause is frontend, backend, permission, routing, or data-state related.
Do not create local replacement systems when shared AiXia components exist.
Add Security panel review when permissions or tenant isolation may be involved.

categories.name: Logical Issue
categories.definition: The page technically works, but business behavior, role visibility, lifecycle state, finance or HR workflow, approval, archive or delete behavior, or data relationship is wrong.
examples: Draft document shows final approval action
Company bank currency does not follow company currency
Vendor bank currency does not use general currency master data
Paid records show editable draft actions
Archived records appear on active registry
Payroll approval and finance payment execution are mixed incorrectly
Employee-facing HR page exposes company-internal HR or admin data
fixPromptRules: Explain why the behavior is wrong against the expected business rule.
Identify whether the cause is frontend visibility, permission, backend, or data-state related.
Preserve existing backend unless an explicit backend or permission fix is required.
Require schema inspection before any uncertain database change.
Route to HR Panel when people data, privacy, or HR workflow boundaries are involved.

categories.name: Technical Issue
categories.definition: A technical failure such as console error, network failure, Supabase error, build error, TypeScript error, hydration error, slow loading, missing environment variable, route error, broken data loading, realtime failure, or silent refresh failure.
requiredEvidence: Timing or performance data when relevant
fixPromptRules: Identify whether the issue is build, frontend, backend, routing, Supabase, environment, or performance related.
Do not guess database columns.
Require schema inspection for Supabase uncertainty.
Preserve visible state during silent refresh and avoid clearing UI on failed refresh.

categories.name: Improvement Suggestion
categories.definition: Not a bug. A product, UX, workflow, AI, SaaS, HR, finance, automation, document, image, report, integration, or performance idea that can improve usefulness, professionalism, uniqueness, commercialization, or ease of use.
examples: AI should help prepare a document
Personal AI should suggest next task
SaaS tenant setup needs guided wizard
requiredEvidence: Whether SaaS readiness, AI or MCP readiness, HR, permissions, or backend are affected
fixPromptRules: Do not become an implementation task until reviewed by the relevant council panels.
Include scope, non-changes, risk, required source files, and implementation plan only after approval.
Reject if redundant, too risky, page-local only, or misaligned with AiXia standards.
Route to SaaS Conversion Panel, AI MCP Panel, Personal AI Panel, or HR Panel based on impact.
